batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c RS Sodhi b IK Pathan

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b IK Pathan

batting.name: R Bhatia
batting.dismissal: c RS Sodhi b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: A Nehra
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b IK Pathan

batting.name: DPMD Jayawardene
batting.dismissal: c A Nehra b PD Collingwood

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c R Bhatia b A Mishra

balls.text: is that a six? Nope, Chawla's on the boundary to catch Nehra's cross-bat heave off the back foot, and that is that.
played back to the bowler
heaved towards deep square leg where Theron runs in and dives forward, trying to take the catch, the ball drops short but he does well to field it
that's too wide outside off, Sanga isn't happy
Mishra goes inside out and lofts the ball over the infield, it gets closer to the boundary but Jayawardene makes the interception
Theron was aiming for the blockhole but bowled a full toss that thudded into Nehra's pads outside leg stump
well well Mishra tries to play a reverse paddle to a full and straight ball and hits it with some part of the bat, the ball goes towards the leg side
flicked off the pads towards long leg

the ball's raced away to the fine leg boundary, but off the stump, not the bat! Manhas moved a long way across his stumps and tried to play the leg glance, Theron kept it full and straight and clipped leg stump
Mishra clears his leg and heaves across the line, he gets an inside edge towards fine leg
full and straight, Manhas clears his front leg and hits the ball to long on
cut to point for a quick single, Mishra responds well to the call
driven towards long on for one
played towards point for  a single
Manhas comes forward and gets hit on the pad, the ball lobs up and Sanga shouts "take it take it" to Chawla, who appeals after catching the ball, the umpire isn't interested
played to point off the back foot
inside out and four! Kotla erupts as Manhas goes forward, waits for a flighted ball and lofts it into the gap on the extra cover boundary, it's only the second boundary since Gambhir's dismissal
Manhas hits across the line and gives Karan Goel an easier piece of fielding this time
Manhas flicks again and the Kotla crowd cheer as the ball runs to the boundary, but Karan Goel speeds to his right this time and dives to save four
Manhas flicks firmly and thinks he has a boundary until Karan Goel sprints to his left and dives to save the four
Mishra gets an inside edge towards long leg
flicked off the pads to deep midwicket
full and straight, it hits the pad and Theron thinks he has a wicket, but Bowden says not out, it was possible missing leg stump
dabbed on the off side for a single
wide ball, Manhas reaches for it and hits towards point for a single
Mishra chops an offcutter towards third man
that's the slower one but it's rather wide outside off stump, he attempted a legcutter there
dangerous shot! Cutting the offcutter from middle stump, he places it in front of point
flicked towards deep midwicket

well what ever Sanga said seems to have worked! Ablish bowled the offcutter on off and middle, Maharoof was caught on the crease and beaten by the slightly low bounce. The ball crashed into middle stump
wide down the leg side, Sangakkara makes a sharp save and runs to his bowler for a word
caught! Bhatia leans forward and closes the face, trying to play the ball from outside off to the leg side. It spins across him and lobs up off the leading edge for Sodhi to take the catch at point
played through cover for a single
beaten, Manhas stays rooted to the crease and tries to defend, the ball drifts into him, there's a puff of dust as it pitches before it turns past the outside edge
pushed off the front foot towards the off side
the batsman steps out of his crease and then defends
driven firmly off the front foot to long off, just the singles coming right now
tight line and length, Manhas stays back and works the ball behind square
Bhatia tries to work the ball off his pads but doesn't make contact
Bhatia drives again and Pathan bends low in his follow through to stop it
played off the front foot to mid-on

attempted big hit and Jayawardene's on the boundary to dash several thousand hopes at the Kotla. Karthik went on the back foot, waited for the length ball and heaved it towards long-on, the trajectory was flat and Jayawardene judged it well on the rope
punchy drive off the front foot to long off
driven fluently down the ground for a single to long off
forced off the back foot towards deep midwicket
dabbed on the leg side for one"
flighted delivery on off stump, driven off the front foot to point
cut off the back foot towards point
tossed up outside off, defended on the front foot to cover
driven off the back foot but it doesn't get past cover
another dot ball, Karthik is taking his time, but he's got plenty
played off the pads to deep backward square
full ball outside off stump, Manhas reaches for it again but misses
played off the back foot towards deep point
he starts with a wide delivery outside off, Karthik reaches for it but misses
bowled quicker, flatter and straighter, Manhas defends on the front foot
Karthik goes back and works the ball off his pads through the leg side
played down the ground off the back foot for one
in the air and just safe! Manhas reaches out for a flighted delivery outside off and drives loosely, spooning the ball in the air and just over the outstretched hand of the fielder at cover
played off the back foot towards square leg
flighted outside off, played to extra cover

bowled him!! Chawla pitches the ball around middle stump, Vettori goes back, expecting the ball to turn into his pads and prepares to play across the line, but it's the googly and it moves across him, beating the bat and clipping the top of off stump
driven towards long-off for a single
dabbed on the off side on the back foot
Karthik's trying to slog sweep the leg break against the turn, poor choice of shot and it didn't work
defended on the front foot this time
tossed up outside off stump, Karthik goes right back, waits and swishes his bat quickly to cut the ball behind point for a pressure-relieving boundary
Vettori tries to sweep but misses, it's time for a time out
driven again but this time in the gap between cover and point
driven firmly but straight to cover
straighter line and Karthik defends on the front foot
Yuvraj tosses it up and wide outside off, Karthik goes after it with the big drive but gets beaten by the turn away from him
Vettori stays low and sweeps from leg stump to short fine leg
Karthik tries to attack Chawla but misses the slog sweep
driven off the front foot towards cover
swept behind square for a single

that is plumb, stone dead! Collingwood went back into his crease to read the ball off the pitch, it was the topspinner and not a legbreak, the ball skidded through and hit the back pad before Collingwood could bring his bat down, the impact was low, don't get easier lbws than that
tossed up on middle stump, Karthik waits and drives the ball off the front foot through wide mid-on
tossed up outside off stump, Collingwood moves towards the line of the ball and drives fluently through cover
quicker and fuller on off and middle, Collingwood plays to point for one
defended on the leg side
he pitches this one straighter and turns it big once again, the ball spins past Collingwood's front pad and beats Sangakkara down the leg side, five more wides
quicker once again, 89 kmh, Karthik drives to long on for one
right, tossed up outside off stump, Karthik strides forward and defends with bat close to pad
the quicker one at 86 kmh, Karthik comes forward and plays on the leg side
defended back to the bowler
Powar rips the ball but it turns outside leg and that's a wide
Collingwood pokes nervously outside off stump and gets an inside edge that goes past Sangakkara
bowled straighter on middle and off, Collingwood goes back and plays the ball to midwicket
it's the googly and Karthik goes right back and plays the ball towards square leg
defended on the front foot once again to the off side
he stretches forward this time and defends
Karthik goes back to cut but gets beaten, that was close to off stump
played on the leg side
has he reverse swept it with the back of his bat? I think he has, and controlled it rather well to third man
defended back to the bowler
tossed up on off and middle, Karthik plays on the leg side
played off the back foot on the leg side

another run out! Is the heat getting to Delhi? Warner cuts the ball to cover point and sets off for a single, this time he is sent back, by Collingwood. Warner turns around, sprints back and throws himself full length in an attempt to make his ground. the throw to Sanga is good this time and Warner is a foot or two short
played to backward point, Yuvi throws needlessly at the bowler's end and concedes overthrows

Gambhir's run out again! That's his fifth of the season I think. He cuts the ball to short third man, Warner calls him for a single, Gambhir responds and then Warner sends him back. Gambhir has no chance, Juan Theron throws the ball to Sangakkara, it isn't a very good one and Sangakkara collects towards his right and flicks the ball backhanded blindly on to the stumps, Gambhir's several yards short and he is fuming, absolutely fuming
this one is straighter and Gambhir is in a spot of trouble, he defends but the ball hits the bat and goes dangerously close to the stumps, Gambhir is out of his crease as well and has to scamper back
short and wide again, Gambhir helps himself to more easy runs, he stays back and cuts in front of point this time
oh that's so wide and Gambhir reaches out for it and dabs the ball through the gap at backward point, way too much width offered
too straight and Gambhir works the ball off his pads through square leg
Warner strides forward and defends one that pitches outside leg and spins into his pad
played off the back foot towards the leg side, Powar's sticking to this leg stump line, he's used it effectively against the lefties - Gayle and Ganguly included
Warner defends, but not very well
Warner moves back and hits the ball hard towards cover where a fumble allows Delhi runs they shouldn't have got

Powar is bowling on leg or outside to deny the left-hander room, Gambhir charges and makes room but gets cramped, he gets an inside edge to fine leg, Warner is super quick and sprints back for the third
defended on the leg side
oh he's tossed this one extremely wide outside leg stump, Sangakkara has no chance, gift-wrapped runs for Delhi
straighter line on off and middle, Gambhir works the ball off his pads through square leg
too wide outside off again, he'll have to bowl one more
superb, the off-side field is strong so Gambhir moves his front foot across, bends low, takes the ball on the full and paddles it to the fine leg boundary
straighter line and better length, Gambhir moves across and dabs on the off side, the infield is packed
more swing but once again the line is too wide, and the length a bit too full, Gambhir waits and drives through cover
he's hit that! Pathan swings the ball away from the left-hander and gives Gambhir too much width, he cuts fiercely through point
Pathan bowls this wider outside off stump, the ball swings too. That's been called wide

Sehwag's gone! A first-baller! Length delivery and it keeps a touch low too, Sehwag aims for the midwicket boundary but doesn't hit it well enough to clear the infield, Sodhi didn't have to move at midwicket
that's 69kmh, can't get much slower than that! It pitches on leg or just outside and spins across Warner, who tries to cut off the back foot but gets beaten by turn and low bounce
Powar is slowing it up and Warner gets beaten on the cut once again, he's waiting for eternity for the ball to reach him
cut off the back foot to point, can't beat the infield
big turn, massive, Powar pitches the ball on leg or just outside and rips the offbreak past Warner's defense, Sanga appeals but Bowden is having none of it
tossed up on leg stump at 71kmh, it stays low and Warner defends on the back foot
short ball first up, it sits up for Warner who goes on the back foot and cuts hard past point, Delhi are away

that's it! Punjab have won. Barath goes down the track and hits to mid-on, he runs the single and has to sprint, Sehwag throws the ball to Vettori who doesn't collect cleanly, he would have been in anyway, it needed a direct hit
played off the back foot to point, the crowd love it, the delay
driven off the front foot to mid-off
played off the back foot to short cover
he's away with a single through point
bowled him! Sangakkara plays down the wrong line and Collingwood hits middle stump
Yuvraj muscles the ball to deep midwicket where Manhas prevents the four with a diving effort
he slog sweeps again and gets a top edge that goes behind Karthik and falls safely before Sehwag reaches it from short fine leg
Yuvraj goes for a massive slog sweep but misses, Collingwood appeals but gets rejected by Bowden
Sangakkara sweeps but Sehwag prevents the four by diving at short fine leg
Yuvraj rocks back this time and pulls powerfully to the deep midwicket boundary, another one of these blows will do it
Yuvraj tries to close the face but gets a leading edge to Vettori
played through midwicket for a single
that's outside leg stump and Sangakkara sweeps it over the head of the fielder at short fine leg
played to midwicket, Sanga wants one but can't find it
short ball and Sangakkara cashes in, rocking back and pulling powerfully to the square leg boundary
Yuvraj lunges forward and blocks and it's time for another of those time-outs, Punjab need 17 off the last 24
nudged off the pads behind square
placement! Sangakkara goes inside out and lofts the ball into the gap on the extra cover boundary
Yuvraj gets down low and sweeps firmly towards long leg
chipped in the air towards long-on, it falls well short of the fielder though
Collingwood beats Sanga's drive with an offbreak, a spinner's offbreak
Mishra appeals after a straighter one hits Yuvraj on the pads, the umpire isn't interested
played behind square on the leg side for one
Yuvraj advances but gets beaten by the flight and has to defend in the end, he gets a leg bye though he seemed to pad it away really
played back to the bowler
what's he trying? Yuvraj attempts a reverse-swat and gets into an awful tangle
driven once again to long off for a single
driven off the front foot to long off
played towards point for one
short ball and Yuvraj heaves it over the deep midwicket boundary, cleared the boundary comfortably that did
on leg stump, but Yuvraj didn't make proper contact with the sweep
defended on the back foot towards the bowler, that kept low
poor ball, on leg stump, and Yuvraj swats it down to the fine leg boundary
good length and straight, Sangakkara plays back to the bowler
95 kmh this time on off stump, nudged on the off side for a single
defended on the front foot, Collingwood is bowling at just under 100 kmh
quicker one and Yuvraj meets it with a forward defense
pushed off the front foot to long on
nudged off the pads behind square for one more
flicked through square leg for a single
He misses the sweep again and gets hit on the pad, there's an appeal for lbw as the ball goes to short third man, Sanga wants the leg bye but Yuvraj says no
Yuvraj tries to slog sweep but misses, the ball was close to off
tossed up by Sehwag, Sangakkara steps out and drives to long on
Yuvraj gets down on one knee and sweeps to long leg
defended solidly on the front foot

caught! Jayawardene attempts the slog sweep but gets a top edge that swirls in the air towards Nehra at short fine leg, he runs back and to his left and then holds on with his fingertips! It wasn't a difficult catch
Sanga goes back and plays the ball through midwicket
played off the pads through midwicket
fraught with risk! Jayawardene moves right across his stumps and paddles the ball virtually over his stumps and past the keeper for four
Jayawardene cuts but can't beat point
dabbed off the back foot to short third man
nudged off the front foot to square leg
Sangakkara gets down on one knee and sweeps to deep square leg
cut off the back foot for one more
arm ball and the batsmen run a single to deep point
flighted delivery and Jayawardene nudges to short fine leg, Sangakkara runs a risky single but the throw from Gambhir is poor
driven to long on for a single
Vettori drifts down leg side, Bowden calls it wide
Sangakkara moves back and pushes the ball towards long on
defended back to the bowler
driven off the back foot towards cover
Sangakkara goes back into his crease and drives to long on
nudged off the back foot towards square leg
pushed off the front foot on the leg side
this time he tries to cut and gets beaten, loses a bit of balance as well
lovely placement, Sanga uses his feet, gets to the ball as it bounces, and chips into the gap between deep midwicket and long on
Jayawardene waits on the back foot and cuts
back and across again and Sangakkara works the ball to square leg
Sangakkara moves back and across and plays the ball to midwicket
Sangakkara advances and plays the ball back to Vettori
defended on the front foot towards the off side
Sangakkara goes back and pushes a flat ball, which keeps low, to cover for one
caught in the deep! Ifran comes down the track and swings his bat hard, hitting the ball in the air and straight to Bhatia on the deep midwicket boundary
played through midwicket for a single

the googly beats Jayawardene's defense and hits the pad, Mishra appeals confidently but Umpire Saheba says not out, that was close, very close but Jayawardene had taken a good stride forward, Jayawardene's lucky there
played through square leg for a single
full ball on leg stump, Pathan drives through midwicket, the Powerplay is over
this time Jayawardene connects with the pull and collects a single to deep midwicket
the slower one and Jayawardene misses the swat through midwicket, that was 98 kmh and just outside off, else Bhatia would have bowled him
Jayawardene makes room and cuts the ball firmly but to the man at backward point
length ball and Jayawardene sends it over mid-off with a full and free swing of his bat, clean strike
pulled off the back foot through square leg
pushed back in the air but just wide of Mishra who dives to his left, they run a single to long on
pushed off the front foot towards point, Jayawardene makes an early call of "No!"
flicked through midwicket for one
Jayawardene charges to hit over extra cover but gets a thick outside edge that clears the infield at backward point, collecting a streaky boundary
shorter length, cut off the back foot to Gambhir at cover
defended back to the bowler, that was 89 kmh and straight, Jayawardene was looking to make room
Jayawardene makes room by moving towards leg, Maharoof follows him, the batsman tries to paddle around the corner but doesn't connect
pushed off the front foot past the bowler and they attempt the single, Warner charges in from mid on and underarms it at the stumps, he misses though, else Ifran was a goner
deftly dabbed to third man for a single
and that's the first six of the match! Jayawardene gets out of his crease and simply hits through the line, clearing the long-on boundary
Jayawardene comes forward and drives the slower ball in the air and just out of the reach of a diving Collingwood, the ball reaches the boundary after beating the infield
Jayawardene tries to pull but the ball isn't coming on to the bat
driven to mid-on for a quick single, Warner's the fielder
Jayawardene tries to pull off the front foot but misses the ball as it angles across him
Jayawardene moves a shade outside leg, he doesn't have enough room to hit inside out and plays to cover
the yorker and Irfan gets hit on the pad, Jayawardene calls him through, might have been an inside edge on it
Irfan stepped out, swung across the line and missed a length ball from Nehra
good length angling into the left-hander, Pathan pushes forward and plays the ball to extra cover
Irfan waits for a length ball and drives to mid off, Jayawardene scampers through
defended back to the bowler on the front foot
slower one, 133 kmh, Jayawardene flicks behind square for one more
Jayawardene made room but the slower ball took an age to reach him, he defended it in the end
good length and straight, the ball stops on Irfan who pushes towards mid-on for one
Jayawardene stays in his crease and flicks a short of a length ball to long leg
Irfan takes two steps down to a length ball and pulls through the gap between midwicket and mid-on
driven square off the front foot
well it looked like he hit that well but the ball didn't even clear the infield behind the bowler's head, Jayawardene looks at the bottom of his bat
too straight and Irfan flicks off his pads to fine leg
good length with swing outside off stump, Irfan leans into the cover drive but can't find the gap
good length with a hint of swing into the right-hander, Jayawardene plays towards midwicket for a single
